nom: Estée Lauder Perfectly Clean Multi-Action Foam Cleanser + Purifying Mask

avis.texte: I received this product as a gift with purchase. The smell is light and smells clean. I was surprised it's scented bc I usually use unscented face washes, but the smell isn't overwhelming. it can be used as a foaming wash or mask. I usually leave it on for a mask, and then suds it out when I wash it off. This has really helped out with my acne breakouts around my chin and cheeks. This product will easily compliment any skincare routine.

I've tried several face cleanser and this is my #1 favorite. I'm the type of person that always reads the reviews before deciding to buy a product. I decided to give this product a try and I immediately fell in love. I love the feeling how smooth and moisturized my face feels after the first wash. I've tried the new Estee lauder face wash, but this one actually works better for me.

I randomly tried this cleanser since I had never found one that I actually liked. No matter how much I spent, nothing actually successfully removed all of my makeup (especially mascara), and I truly don't wear much makeup. This one removes my makeup and makes my face feel super clean. I would have easily given 5 stars, but the smell knocked off a star for me. It is quite strong and just unpleasant to me. Smells like something my grandma might enjoy. Just my opinion.

I love this face wash for its universal nature. Both my mom and I can use it successfully, as it cleans gently without stripping the skin of its oils. Good for aging and sensitive skin. Thank you to Estée!

I love using this in the morning! It makes my face feel super clean. It does feel a little dry right after you pat your face dry, but of course, if you moisturize, you'll be fine. For a combo skin like mine, its perfect!
Works well on my oily skin. Does not have a strong smell. A little gies a long way. So it lasts forever.

This is the best cleanser I have ever used. My skin feels significantly cleaner immediately after I rinse my face. Literally makes my skin squeaky clean and feeling totally purified. My sample of this is almost used up and I'm definitely buying the full size and replacing my other cleansers with this one. My complexion is so much clearer now and my makeup sets much better when I start my day fresh with this. A little goes a long way and the frothy texture feels luxurious. It's also gentle on my sensitive skin. This stuff is the jackpot, I absolutely love it.

avis.titre: It's ok… but gave it burning sensation after rinsing
avis.texte: It cleaned my face really well but gave it burning sensation after rinsing.
Way too much fragrance. Every time I used it my face broke out like a teenager. Disappointed. Expected much more from Estée Lauder
Love this. Smells good. Lathers supremely. Feels clean after.

avis.titre: I really did not like this
avis.texte: I got this as a test sample and found it really unpleasant. It has a strong perfumy smell and left my face feeling stripped. And it was hard to wash off. I'm glad I got a sample so I know not to buy this.

avis.titre: Perfect cleanser for my sensitive, combo skin
avis.texte: I have used many different brands of cleansers/masks. Generic to luxury high priced. Amidst my journey I stubmped upon this one along the way and have not cheated since. Aside from the occasional - hormonal, once a month break outs, this cleansing mask has done the job time and time again. My skin is sensetive to fragrance and abrasion. This silky smooth texture lathers perfectly onto my skin and goes to work instantly. I like to leave it lathered on my skin while brushing my teeth. Its a greak mask and cleanser all in one. Estee lauder has an exfoliator ("perfectly clean multi-action cleansing gele/refiner") that I love to use 2-3 times a week. It lightly exfoliates and preps the skin for the cleansing mask. My skin never feels dried out after using these products. I would recomend to anybody that has normal to combo skin.

avis.titre: LOVE THIS FACE WASH FOR MY OILY COMBINATION GIRLIES!
avis.texte: This face wash will leave your face feeling super clean! It foams up so amazingly!

avis.titre: LOVE THIS FACE WASH FOR MY OILY COMBINATION GIRLIES!
avis.texte: This face wash will leave your face feeling super clean! It foams up so amazingly!

I got a sample of this from my mom, and I loved it so much I splurged on the full size one. I have pretty dry skin and this is the only cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and doesn't dry it out. It's so soft to use, I find it almost therapeutic.
I absolutely love this product and wish it were still available in my local Ulta store. I love the way it cleanses my skin without drying it out. A little goes a long way.

avis.titre: I want to love this, but
avis.texte: The fragrance is holding me back for giving this 5 stars. There's a lot of great things going on here. It foams up beautifully and it feels like a dream when used as a cleanser. The effectiveness of this as a mask almost knocked me off my feet. I did as instructed and applied to dry skin for 3 minutes. When washed it off my pores seemed to have spit up what're was clogging them. I can't say I've ever had such an immediate and positive result with a mask. However, because the fragrance is so strong, I couldn't wait to was this off. It's not an unpleasant scent, I just which I could turn it down about 80%. I got this as a sample and I'm not sure if I'll use it again solely because of the smell. I highly recommend this if strong fragrances don't bother you, but if they do, stay clear!
This is the best cleanser out there for me personally. Works well for my oily combo skin. Smells nice.
this made my skin feel weird and waxy. about a week into using it my face broke out severly.

This cleanser is amazing. The first time i used it was from some 1oz samples that i had lying around and it cleared my skin immediately! The price may be a bit in the luxury zone for a face wash for a lot of people but this face wash is for "normal skin" however my skin tends to go from dry in winters to oily in summers and this stuff is great for both times. It doesnt strip my skin of its oils at all. I have tried many face washes from drunk elephant, neutrogena stuff, and even glossier. All of those irritate my skin in some way or strip it to where it feels dry and flakey. Not this cleanser though. It cleans while keeping my skin smooth and healthy.
I really wanted to love this face wash but didn't clean my face very well..I still had a ton of makeup left behind😫

avis.titre: I'm not a cleanser expert but...
avis.texte: I'm not a cleanser expert but this stuff is amazing. My skin has never felt so soft and clean. I have pretty normal skin that's generally clear, and this makes my face feel fantastic.

This is a great cleanser for my combo skin. It took off every speck of make up, including my hard to remove foundation. This left my face feeling clean but not stripped. I have not tried this as a mask. I wouldn't recommend this for dry skin as I think it would be too harsh. I love it.
Great cleanser! Cleans your face without leaving it dry. My face is combination oily.

I use this cleanser every night to wash off the day and it does a great job! Smells great and you don't need much to work up a great lather. Bought it half off during days a beauty, will definitely buy again!!
Awesome product for getting a deep clean. My skin is typically dry but I do like to have a deep clean feeling at times...especially wearing masks. I recently tried applying as a mask and it was nice.

avis.titre: My face has never felt so clean!
avis.texte: I use this product morning and night and my face has never felt cleaner while using any other cleanser! I bought it during the skincare event when it was half off to try, and I will continue buying it for full price once I run out cause I feel it's worth it! A little goes a long way as well! I also love that it foams up as well for a more purifying effect!

It's not bad, it works to take off my makeup, and it has a nice smell. I personally would rather use the IT Cosmetics Cleanser though. I will keep this cleanser around for when I run out of my IT Confidence in a Cleanser.
i have never had a product that after using it my skin has felt /that/ clean. loved everything about this.
I love this cleanser! Leaves your skin feeling so fresh, new and clean! Very gentle on your skin & doesn't irritate your eyes. Nice light scent.

avis.titre: Another free trial size that turned into a purchase
avis.texte: A tiny pea sized amount is more than enough to wash thoroughly - the way it foams up is amazing. I use it with a mini silicone fingertip scrubby that came with a different face wash and am hooked. Definitely avoid the eyes, but twice a week makes my face feel so much cleaner!

I use this product every morning and every night. I love it! It only took one sample for me to get hooked. I like how it only takes a little bit of product to cleanse your face. It's a gentle foam that feels so good on your face! Definitely recommend!

First, it only takes about a pea size of product to remove all makeups from face, no mascara residue left. Rub product between both palms and the product will increase in size to be plenty for your face. Wonderful smell, smooth feeling on face, rinses easily and completely. No problems or issues at all. My favorite product ever!!!

avis.titre: Leaves My Face Feeling Clean & Firm!
avis.texte: I love that I can use this every day as a cleanser, and then as a purifying mask when needed. It leaves my face feeling clean and firm. I've used this cleanser for almost a year, and my skin has never been clearer!

avis.titre: Estée Lauder's perfectly clean foam face wash is WONDERFUL!
avis.texte: I LOVE THIS Perfectly Clean foam face wash! I'm 55yrs old and believe me, I've used every face wash known to woman! I use to use another face wash but they stopped making it! Then I found this one. I love everything about this face wash! It removes my makeup, cleans my face without drying it out and I love the way it smells! Yes, I know it's a bit expensive, however it's worth every penny and a small amount goes a long way! So it last a lot longer than the cheaper face washes! TRY IT! YOU WILL LOVE IT! Especially ladies My age!
This formula really works for my combination skin. A little goes a long way. Also you get a ton of product for the money - this bottle lasts forever!
I really did not like this product. It made my skin extremely dry and I really couldn't get past the smell. Not very pleasant smelling.
I have been using for over 3 years and this is by far the best face wash.

avis.titre: DO NOT GET IN YOUR EYES
avis.texte: i've accidentally put jalapenos in my eyes before, and honestly, putting getting this product in my eye accidentally is on equal terms to hot peppers. I'm throwing it away and never using it again. I couldn't open my eye for 30 minutes even after rinsing. I can't believe this has such good reviews when it's borderline dangerous to use it, I was so close to going to an immediate care because it hurt so badly.
Works amazingly well! Face feels great afterward. Has lasted 4-5 months. Works great with Clarisonic brushes. The only negative is the strong smell, something one would remember Grandma by.

avis.titre: Great Daily Cleaner for All Skin Types
avis.texte: I have had this product for months and have hardly made a dent in it. A little goes a long way and I use about a pea size amount per use. Love that this product gives a squeaky clean feel without any tightness or dryness. Just feels refreshing!

avis.titre: I feel this cleanser is too harsh for delicate skin
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser because I use several Estee Lauder products that I really like. This cleanser however, has a very strong fragrance. I usually don't mind a slight fragrance in my cleansers, but this is simply too strong. Like, way too strong! It also burns the absolute heck out of my eyes if it gets near them. My eyes aren't too sensitive if a gentle cleanser accidentally gets in them, but this product burns like no other! I do like the feel of cleanliness it delivers and it makes my skin feel squeaky clean. Bottom line, if you can stand a cleanser with a bottle of perfume dumped into it and don't mind pouring alcohol in your eyes, then this cleanser is for you!
I use this AM and PM to clean my face. It removes makeup throughly and really gets into your pores. Highly recommend this face cleanser. ❤️🧖🏻‍♀️

avis.titre: I would buy this cleanser again
avis.texte: Smell great . It left my face feel fresh n clean. I would buy this product again

avis.titre: A little goes a LONG WAYS!! Great stuff for middle age too!
avis.texte: I'm middle aged and this cleanser is wonderful... a little goes a long ways! Skin feels and looks smoother.

As to be expected with A "Lauder" cleanser it over-performs! Leaves me clean, luminous, soft, and balanced. I used it as a mask too, and my skin was luminous! I already feel my skin looks better than it has in years.
I love the smell of this item and the special price was great. I should have ordered more!!!

avis.titre: What a fabulous cleanser and mask combination!
avis.texte: No surprise that this Estee Lauder product is top quality! It smells fabulous, makes my face feel and look great, and a little goes a very long way. You have the option of either using it as a cleanser or a mask, either way my face feels supple, soft, clean, and well hydrated after using it.

Will highly recommend it as it leaves skin cleansed and you do not have to use very much. Gentle to skin, nice aroma. Tube lasts about a year with daily wash twice a day. I use about a "pea" sized amount each time.

I wanted to test how good this actually cleaned my face so I left ALL of my makeup on. (I was wearing 2 thin layers of Estee Lauder double wear foundation underneath the powder.) I followed the instructions where it says to leave on three minutes then rinse off. I used a toner on my face afterward to see how much makeup was left and there was literally nothing that showed up on the cotton ball. My face feels extremely clean! I will definitely repurchase this in the future. If you're curious on skin type, I usually have oily skin, but since I have been pregnant my face has been extremely dry, so I am using this and It cosmetics confidence in a cream. So far, so good.
This makes my skin feel sooo dry! It also feels like it leaves a residue on my skin, my face doesn't feel clean at all after I use it.

Finally solved an ongoing issue. My pores have been congested on my cheeks and clogged with whiteheads on my nose. I've been trying everything. This facial wash twice a day with a brush is definitely shrinking my pores. I also use night repair serum and vit c and a good moisturizer. I'm drinking plenty of fluids too.

Looked for a good face wash for many years. This is my all-time favorite can't wait to put it on to smell it if I get sidetracked I put it on again so I can smell the fragrance in the shower. Never breaks my skin out absolutely love it

This dries out your skin like crazy and when your using it, your hand won't slide on your face. It's hard to explain, its like how bar soap would feels when using it. Plus it burns the eyes which my other cleaners would not do that.

I am a skin care fanatic. When I shop online I rely on reviews & honest feedback. I am long overdue in giving reviews for my favorite products. This is one of them. It feels like liquid silk when you apply it. My face feels really clean, I don't feel there is anything residual left over. My pores look smaller, skin texture better, it's simply amazing. It lasts forever & I also use it as a face mask. This is a fantastic deal for the price, you only use a small amount. I highly recommend!

I actually have been sitting on the mini version of this product for months without even realizing it. I received it as a gift with purchase from a department store many months ago. I finally gave in and used it because I needed a tiny face wash to pack on a trip to London (super strict airport liquid rules) recently, and fell. In. Love.! Seriously. I flew through the small bottle within a couple of weeks, and I had to have the bigger version. I hate that it can't be purchased in the store, but that's okay. As for the product itself: it leaves my skin feeling wonderful! I pair this with the Foreo facial brush cleanser brush, and my skin feels so freaking soft after washing with these two! Wanting to have my hands on this product in store, I purchased the perfectly clean triple action foam pump, but it just doesn't hold up to the actual quality of the multi action foam cleanser. This stuff smells SO good; I have sensitive skin, and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. It's left feeling smooth, extremely clean, and pure. I love it. I will definitely keep buying this, even with the price tag!

This was my very first ever high end skin care purchase. I brought this when I was a teenager. That time I had oily skin. this product worked amazing to clean my face. I wore makeup back then and i always felt like it removed my left over makeup that is not visible to the eye. Now as a adult I have dry skin. still use this! this is a all skin type product for sure! It cleans my face without over drying it which I LOVE!

I absolutely love this product! The foam is so luxurious! I only wish my local Ulta still stocked it instead of waiting for it to be delivered. I used to pick it up there but all of a sudden they stopped carrying it in store. I much rather go to Ulta for my products so I can browse all the great beauty finds.
Really makes my skin feel squeaky clean. I got a sample of this and can't wait to buy the real one!
